title: Joel Bible Quiz - Chapter 1
description: Ten questions on Joel 1: the locust plague, the mourning priests and the day of Yahweh at hand.

questions.text: Whose son is Joel, according to verse 1?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says this is Yahweh's word that came to Joel, the son of Pethuel.

questions.text: According to verse 4, what has eaten what the grasshopper left?
questions.explanation: What the swarming locust left the great locust ate, what the great locust left the grasshopper ate, and what the grasshopper left the caterpillar ate.

questions.text: Who is told to wake up and weep in verse 5?
questions.explanation: The drunkards are told to wake up and weep, and all drinkers of wine to wail, because the sweet wine is cut off from their mouth.

questions.text: What does verse 6 say about the nation that has come up on the land?
questions.explanation: A nation has come up on the land, strong and without number, with the teeth of a lion and the fangs of a lioness.

answers.text: It is small but very cunning
It comes from the sea in ships
It is led by a king of Assyria
It is strong and without number

questions.text: Which two plants does verse 7 say were laid waste and stripped?
questions.explanation: He has laid the vine waste and stripped the fig tree, stripping its bark and throwing it away.

answers.text: The vine and the fig tree

questions.text: Which two offerings are cut off from Yahweh's house, according to verse 9?
questions.explanation: The meal offering and the drink offering are cut off from Yahweh's house, and the priests, Yahweh's ministers, mourn.

answers.text: The meal offering and the drink offering
The burnt offering and the sin offering
The peace offering and the guilt offering

questions.text: For which crops are the farmers and vineyard keepers told to wail?
questions.explanation: The farmers are told to be confounded and the vineyard keepers to wail for the wheat and for the barley, because the harvest of the field has perished.

questions.text: What are the priests told to do all night, according to verse 13?
questions.explanation: The priests and ministers of the altar are told to put on sackcloth, mourn and lie all night in sackcloth.

questions.text: How does verse 15 say the day of Yahweh will come?
questions.explanation: The day of Yahweh is at hand, and it will come as destruction from the Almighty.

answers.text: As rain on the mown grass
As a thief in the night
As a feast for the nations

questions.text: Why do the animals of the field pant to God in verse 20?
questions.explanation: The animals of the field pant to him because the water brooks have dried up and fire has devoured the pastures of the wilderness.

answers.text: The water brooks have dried up
The nations have taken them away
